question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sailor
solution:
The correct answer is **"Mariner."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **'sailor' **means a person who works on a ship or boat. (नाविक (जहाज़ का कर्मचारी या नाव को चलाने वाला))

 
 
• **Example**: *My grandfather was a **sailor**__ in the navy for 20 years.*
 
 
 
• The synonym of **'sailor' **is** 'mariner.'**
 
• It means a person who works on a ship or boat. (नाविक, मल्लाह)
 __
 
• **Example**: *Many a **mariner**__ lost his life on these rocks.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 (Prosecutor)**: A prosecutor is a lawyer who brings charges against someone in a court of law. (अदालत में किसी पर अपराध के लिए अभियोग लगाने वाला सरकारी अधिकारी; अभियोजक)
 
• **Option 2 (Enterpriser)**: An enterpriser is a person who starts or manages a business enterprise. (वह व्यक्ति जो किसी व्यावसायिक उद्यम को शुरू या प्रबंधित करता है)
